comparison.objective: Separate two snap-connected case halves, rather than tune and retain a damping setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual opposing pull against a tongue and spring plunger; shares counterholding generically but lacks tool insertion, rotary adjustment, relocking, and iterative impact diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Tongue is extracted and halves remain at least 3 cm apart; a one-sided pull fails. No energy absorption or setting retention criterion exists.
comparison.reason: Tests cooperative force application for disassembly, not adjustable-mechanism commissioning.
